spec.title: Total requests
spec.description: Inbound server spans (any status) tagged with http.route.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && span.http.route != nil } && status = error | count_over_time() by (span.http.route)

spec.title: Read me — if Loki panels show “No data”

options.content:
**How this dashboard reads Faro data**

Faro telemetry is stored in your **Grafana Cloud Logs** Loki data source. Grafana Cloud promotes the Faro attributes `app_id`, `kind` (and `app_key`) to **labels** — there is no `app` label. Queries therefore select `{app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"}`.

**If panels show “No data”:**
1. Set the **Loki** data source to the `-logs` instance (name ends in `-logs`), not `…-usage-insights`.
2. Pick your app in the **Faro app id** dropdown (All is fine). If it is empty, run `{kind="event"}` in Explore — no results means frontend telemetry is not reaching this stack (check the collector URL / redeploy).
3. Verify fields parse: `{kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_view"` should return lines.

The **Server (Tempo)** row needs server-side OTLP env vars (`OTEL_*`) deployed; it stays empty until then.
